while True:
    page = apis.spotify.show_playlist_library(access_token=spotify_token, page_index=page_index, page_limit=page_limit)

    if not page:
        break
    all_playlists.extend(page)
    page_index += 1

# Step 2: compile unique song_ids across all playlists already fetched
unique_song_ids = sorted({sid for p in all_playlists for sid in p.get('song_ids', [])})
print('unique_song_ids_count', len(unique_song_ids))
print('song_ids', unique_song_ids)

indie_keyword = 'indie'
indie_songs = []
checked = 0
song_genres_counter = {}
for sid in unique_song_ids:
    s = apis.spotify.show_song(song_id=sid)
    checked += 1
    genre = (s.get('genre') or '')
    genre_lower = genre.lower()
    song_genres_counter[genre] = song_genres_counter.get(genre, 0) + 1
    is_indie = indie_keyword in genre_lower
    if is_indie:
        indie_songs.append({
            'song_id': sid,
            'title': s.get('title'),
            'genre': genre,
            'artists': s.get('artists', [])
        })

print('checked_songs', checked)
print('unique_genres', len(song_genres_counter))
print('song_genres_counter', song_genres_counter)
print('indie_songs_count', len(indie_songs))
print('indie_songs', [(x['song_id'], x['title'], x['genre'], [a['name'] for a in x['artists']]) for x in indie_songs])
